text:
I recently ordered food online and requested delivery. When the food arrived, it was delivered by a cyclist. Unfortunately, everything was stone cold when we got it, and the bag was not wet but felt damp. I would like to have the option to choose that my food is delivered by car or at least have the option to chose. If I wasn't feeling so lazy and just wanted to stay home on Christmas day, I would have just picked it up myself. I could have driven there and picked it up in half the time that it took to have it delivered on a bicycle. I ordered two regular Cokes, but both of them were Diet Coke, which is disgusting. Also, why does the app divert the order to a McDonald's that is further away? There are two McDonald's within a half a kilometer of my location, but the app chose to deliver from one that is 5 km away???

The burger looked like it had been sat on, the Mcnuggets were stone cold, and the fries were not fresh. I was surprised because I have driven to this McDonald's many times and always gotten home with hot fries.

Deliver fee $3.99
Service Fee $2.66
Courier Tip $ 4.79

Payed a premium for this type of service, $11.44 in fees ????
author: rwpow

text: I grew up in Vancouver and would regularly go to this McDonald's as it was one of the best. At a time in which you could get a meal deal for $2.99 on Tuesday's. Who'd ever guessed that the cost for a lesser meal would be five times higher. This was my first visit to this McDonald's in over twenty-five years and I will never go back. Myself and my two sons placed a large order at the drive-thru and we were asked to pull ahead while they put our order together. After waiting over ten minutes, half the order was cold and missing several items. My son took the order and went into the restaurant to get everything sorted out, but encountered an employee that couldn't understand what he was trying to explain. He gave up and we were still shorted two burgers. We all know that drive-thrus make mistakes, but you shouldn't have to explain yourself three times in order to get what you paid for. This is very common at every fast food restaurant nowadays which is why I've boycotted every one of them. Hire Canadians first for Canadian jobs because the labor that you're hiring doesn't understand nor do they care about customer service.
author: Darcy Padgham

text: Horrible service here. I ordered 20 nuggets, 3 honey sauce, spicy habanero sauce, quarter pounder with NO onions and EXTRA pickles, and a medium root beer. First of all my friends and I have to wait nearly 40 minutes for our order and when I kept asking them whether or not they're making it the staff kept saying they were working on it but we wouldn't get our food. Then I find out that they gave SOMEONE ELSE our order without double checking the other person's receipt on whether or not it was the correct order. Then after asking them 5 times to make ours they only give us 17 nuggets, 2 honey sauce, spicy habanero sauce, and did not take out the onions from the burger. Also did not receive our root beer and the staff would just ignore us when we would ask politely. My friend is deathly allergic to onions too so she wasn't able to have her burger. I understand it was crowded but that is no way to go about our order. Horrible customer service and I'm very disappointed by this location. They also refused us a refund for not giving us our full order. Terrible place and I will never come back here.

text:
I usually enjoy visiting McDonald’s, but my recent experience was quite disappointing. The service was slow, and the staff seemed unorganized. My order took much longer than expected, and when it finally arrived, it was incorrect and not fresh — the fries were cold, and the burger was poorly assembled.

When I tried to speak with a staff member, they didn’t seem very interested in resolving the issue, which made the experience even more frustrating. Cleanliness was also not up to the usual standard; tables were messy, and no one seemed to be attending to the dining area.

I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and improves customer service, food quality, and cleanliness. I’ve had good experiences at other McDonald’s locations, but this one definitely needs attention.
Note:There is a manager name kawal do not know how to talk with customers. Always use headphones during the work. And also have very bad behaviour.

text:

I Double check with the Staff if I am getting a Strawberry Shake before stepping in the Acceclator to keep hitting the road, because the Shake in the cup didn't look pink like a Strawberry Shake, the Staff at the window told me Yes, Strawberry. So I trusted her and left. After 5 minutes while I'm 2 km away from there, I told a sip, Oh.... it is not Strawberry, instead Chocolate, the taste I dislike the most. I open the lid and find that the color is light brown, that's why it's not Strawberry. And the Shake is not thick at all, it's like regular thin Shake.
Can't really trust what they said, next time I will try it first before I leave for sure.

text:
General recommendation - try to avoid this place.

This is the worst McDonald's I have ever visited, and I have probably been to more than 100 all around the world.
- It is always dirty; I have never seen it clean.

- The food is average, but they often get your order wrong.

- Even if you choose the option to eat in, they give you a to-go bag.

- The waiting time is around 15 minutes, but on several occasions, I have waited for more than 20. This is unacceptable for fast food.

- The staff almost always marks your order as ready very quickly, but when you follow the information on the screen and approach them, they tell you to wait and that they will call your number when it’s ready.
